info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fiduciary Agreement API
info.description: The Fiduciary Agreement API provides access to the terms and conditions related to fiduciary agreements in the banking sector. This service allows stakeholders to retrieve detailed information about existing agreements, ensuring transparency and compliance with financial regulations. Financial institutions, legal teams, and compliance officers typically use this endpoint to understand and verify agreement specifics. With this API, users can efficiently manage their fiduciary obligations and enhance their operational workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of the Fiduciary Agreement associated with deposit lending. It provides all relevant information required to understand the terms and conditions outlined in the agreement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding fiduciary agreements in the deposit lending context. It should contain relevant parameters necessary to specify the required details of the fiduciary agreement.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the fiduciary agreement.
